nodes.name: DELETE /api/diagrams/{diagram_id}/edits/{format}/{depth}
nodes.doc: Reset: discard the saved edit; the generated text is shown again.

nodes.name: GET /api/diagrams/{diagram_id}/nodes/{node_id}
nodes.doc: Details of one box. `depth` is the viewed depth (default: the diagram's own).

nodes.name: GET /api/diagrams/{diagram_id}/views/{format}/{depth}
nodes.doc: The diagram as `format` rolled up to `depth` (1 = top-level components only).

nodes.name: GET /api/fs/dirs
nodes.doc: Sub-directories of `path` (default: the home folder), for the folder browser.

nodes.name: PUT /api/diagrams/{diagram_id}/edits/{format}/{depth}
nodes.doc: Save the user's edited text for this view (text equal to the generated one clears it).

nodes.name: _Builder
nodes.doc: Turns one container's folder tree into Component objects (parents before children).

nodes.name: detect_components
nodes.doc: Fill container.components (a tree, parents first); return file path -> leaf component id.

nodes.name: Detected
nodes.doc: A container plus the raw facts later stages (externals, relations) need.

nodes.name: load_manifests
nodes.doc: Per-directory merged manifest info, and whether the root declares workspaces.

nodes.name: node_details
nodes.doc: `depth` is the depth of the view the user clicked in; it decides hub status only.

nodes.name: find_by_dep
nodes.doc: Catalogue entry for an imported/declared package name, if any.

nodes.name: clone_repo
nodes.doc: Shallow-fetch one ref into the cache (init + fetch handles branches, tags and SHAs).

nodes.name: parse_repo_url
nodes.doc: Accept https://github.com/owner/repo(.git) and owner/repo.

nodes.name: resolve_commit
nodes.doc: Commit a ref currently points to (cheap `git ls-remote`), or None if unknown.

nodes.name: build_file_model
nodes.doc: Python, TypeScript and JavaScript files of every container (with a component), with ids.

nodes.name: layer_graph
nodes.doc: Order, layer, transitively reduce and span-limit a dependency graph.

nodes.name: order_nodes
nodes.doc: Linear order, dependents first, with few heavy edges pointing backwards.

nodes.name: fingerprint
nodes.doc: Identity of a folder's content: path, size and mtime of every scanned file.

nodes.name: git_files
nodes.doc: Files git tracks or does not ignore (.gitignore honoured); None if root is not a git repo.

nodes.name: list_dirs
nodes.doc: Sub-directories of `raw` (default: home). Names only; never reads file contents.

nodes.name: open_local
nodes.doc: The folder is analysed in place; the commit is set from the scan (`fingerprint`).

nodes.name: extract_imports
nodes.doc: Imports of one file; a file that cannot be read yields no imports.

nodes.name: read_js_file
nodes.doc: Imports, whether the file contains JSX, and its source text (for the Imports view).

nodes.name: reduce_components
nodes.doc: Merge the smallest top-level components of the busiest container into 'Other <container>'.

nodes.name: scan_repo
nodes.doc: `only`: relative posix paths to consider (e.g. what git does not ignore); None = all.

nodes.name: DiagramCreate
nodes.doc: A GitHub repo (`url`, optional `ref`) or a local folder (`path`); exactly one.

nodes.name: DiagramCreated
nodes.doc: Exactly one is set: a new job to follow, or an existing diagram to reuse.

nodes.name: DiagramRecord
nodes.doc: A generated diagram as stored in SQLite.

nodes.name: DiagramSummary
nodes.doc: History list row: everything except the Mermaid texts and the model.

nodes.name: DiagramView
nodes.doc: One rendering of a diagram: a format at a depth, plus the user's saved edit if any.

nodes.name: DirListing
nodes.doc: Sub-directories of a folder, for the folder browser (SPEC §5.6).

nodes.name: ImportsSummary
nodes.doc: What the Imports view shows and what it left out (SPEC §9.4).

nodes.name: LayersSummary
nodes.doc: What the Dependency graph shows and what it left out (SPEC §9.3).

nodes.name: NodeDetails
nodes.doc: What the details panel shows for one box of a diagram (SPEC §9.5).

nodes.name: NodeLink
nodes.doc: One dependency of a box, as the details panel lists it.

nodes.name: SavedEdit
nodes.doc: Which views the user has saved an edit for (the text comes from the view endpoint).

nodes.name: SourceFile
nodes.doc: A Python, TS or JS source file, classified for the Imports view (SPEC §9.4).

nodes.name: render_c4
nodes.doc: `C4Component` with a Container_Boundary per container and nested boundaries for folders.

nodes.name: label
nodes.doc: Make free text safe inside a double-quoted Mermaid string.

nodes.name: make_id
nodes.doc: Unique Mermaid-safe id ([A-Za-z0-9_]), registered in `used`.

nodes.name: drawn_relations
nodes.doc: The edges the flowchart draws, and the hubs (id -> dependents) it marks instead of wiring.

nodes.name: analyze_layers
nodes.doc: Layer the import graph of the boxes visible at `depth` plus the externals imports reach.

nodes.name: auto_depth
nodes.doc: Deepest level whose diagram has at most `cap` components (at least 1).

nodes.name: find_hubs
nodes.doc: Components that a large part of the diagram depends on, with their number of dependents.

nodes.name: isolated_data_dir
nodes.doc: Never touch the real history database or clone cache from tests.

nodes.name: remote
nodes.doc: A fake 'github': <base>/owner/repo.git with two commits and a branch.

nodes.name: view_edges
nodes.doc: Relations as drawn at `depth`, keyed by (source, target).

nodes.name: comps
nodes.doc: Components of one level, by name (level 1 = the top-level folders).

nodes.name: test_v1_database_is_migrated_in_place
nodes.doc: A database written by the first release keeps its diagrams and saved edits.

nodes.name: test_v2_database_is_migrated_to_v3_keeping_edits
nodes.doc: v2 restricted edits.format in SQL; v3 lets the API decide, so new view formats work.

nodes.name: test_big_containers_get_folder_level_leaves
nodes.doc: Over FILE_LEVEL_MAX_FILES files, leaves are folders; a group keeps its direct files together as one "Files" leaf instead of one component per file.

nodes.name: tree
nodes.doc: {(depth, name): component} for the first container.

nodes.name: test_golden_file
nodes.doc: Expected text; the frontend also parses it with the pinned Mermaid.

nodes.name: _implied
nodes.doc: Is forward edge e = (s, t) reachable through another direct dependency of s?

nodes.name: test_nested_golden_files
nodes.doc: Expected text per depth; the frontend also parses these with the pinned Mermaid.

nodes.name: test_nested_golden_files
nodes.doc: The expected text for the nested sample at every depth; the frontend also checks that all of these parse with the pinned Mermaid (src/golden-mermaid.test.ts).

nodes.name: hub_model
nodes.doc: `util` plus `users` components that import it, each also importing the next one.

nodes.name: nested_model
nodes.doc: c1: a{a1,a2}, b{b1}, z ; c2: x{x1} ; external db. a1->a2 stays inside a.

nodes.name: small_model
nodes.doc: a (group) -> a1, a2 ; b (leaf at level 1) ; relations only between leaves.

nodes.name: test_edges_stay_consistent_across_depths
nodes.doc: Rolling up never invents or loses coupling: total strength to an external is constant.

nodes.name: test_view_node_count_matches_what_auto_depth_budgets
nodes.doc: `nodes` (shown to users) and `auto_depth` (picks the default) must count the same boxes.

nodes.name: getNode
nodes.doc: Details of one box (`nodeId` is its Mermaid id); `depth` is the depth of the view clicked in.

nodes.name: getView
nodes.doc: The diagram as `format` rolled up to `depth`, plus the saved edit for that exact view.

nodes.name: listDirs
nodes.doc: Sub-directories of `path` (default: the home folder), for the folder browser.

nodes.name: useDiagramEditor
nodes.doc: Editor state for one diagram. A "view" is a format at a depth, and each view has its own text: unsaved draft > saved edit > generated. A draft equal to what is saved is not a draft. Switching view keeps the previous one on screen (read-only) until the new text has loaded.

nodes.name: DepthControl
nodes.doc: Picks how many folder levels are expanded (1 = top-level components only).

nodes.name: DetailsPanel
nodes.doc: Everything the model knows about the clicked box (SPEC §9.5).

nodes.name: DiagramPane
nodes.doc: Pan/zoom rendering of `text`, with fit-to-screen and Copy. Fits once per `fitKey`.

nodes.name: ImportsStrip
nodes.doc: The colour key of the Imports view, plus what it left out so nothing is silently lost.

nodes.name: LayersStrip
nodes.doc: What the Dependency graph shows, and (so nothing is silently lost) what it left out.

nodes.name: MermaidView
nodes.doc: Renders Mermaid text into SVG. A failed render never clears the last good one; the error is reported through `onResult` instead (null = rendered fine).

nodes.name: Fold
nodes.doc: Which panes are open: both, the code only (diagram folded) or the diagram only.

nodes.name: summarizeError
nodes.doc: The useful part of a Mermaid parse error, plus the line number when it names one.

nodes.name: useDebounced
nodes.doc: `value`, delayed by `ms`. A change of `key` (a new document/tab) applies immediately.

nodes.name: useSystemDark
nodes.doc: Follows the system theme (SPEC §4.2).

commits.subject: Imports view beyond React (M12, SPEC §9.6): Python and plain TS/JS files, language-neutral kinds, tool 0.6.0
UI refresh (M13, SPEC §9.7): shared button, field and segmented-control styles; framed diagram; dismissible warnings
Add the details panel (M11, SPEC §9.5): click a box to see its details, uses and used-by
Add local folder input (M10, SPEC §5.6): path in POST /api/diagrams, fingerprint identity, .gitignore, source field (schema v4, tool 0.5.0), folder browser
Add the Imports view for React file graphs (M9, SPEC §9.4) and favicon
Add the Dependency graph view (M8, simpler form)
Show components as a nested tree with a depth control and a clearer flowchart
